text: Please treat invoice INV-20418 as a blocking issue: our PO-55190 authorizes USD 18,000 for the annual Team renewal, yet Lumen has billed USD 180,000 and our month-end close cannot proceed until the correction is confirmed. We need a corrected invoice or credit memo issued today so finance operations can release payment before our contract renewal date of 30 June. Please reference contract MSA-2024-117 and confirm that no collection action will be taken while this is resolved.

Our ACH payment for renewal invoice INV-20502 was confirmed by Northbridge Bank on 12 May, but Lumen's portal still marks the invoice unpaid and has sent two dunning notices to our treasury team. The amount is USD 42,750 under PO-61884, and the mismatch is interfering with our reconciliation for contract MSA-2023-044. Please review the payment status and suppress further notices until the record is corrected.

Could you update the tax profile for our workspace so that our VAT exemption certificate, provided under vendor ID Lumen-EMEA-229, is applied to future invoices? The current invoices are charging 20% VAT on our annual subscription of GBP 96,000, although our procurement file confirms exemption under contract UK-PO-2025-118. Please confirm the adjusted treatment before the next renewal invoice is generated on 1 July.

Please send a PDF copy of invoice INV-20366 for our audit folder, including the line items for 250 Team seats and the Salesforce connector. Our PO reference is PO-72345 and the subscription year is covered by contract MSA-2024-118. A standard copy without payment details is sufficient.

We need a refund review for 40 unused analyst seats purchased under PO-59021 on the annual Enterprise plan. Our contract allows a pro-rata adjustment if seat counts fall below 80% of the committed quantity within the first 90 days, and we reduced from 200 to 160 seats on 2 May. Please calculate the credit for invoice INV-20488 and confirm how it will be applied to the remaining term.

Scheduled board report Lumen-Daily is arriving at 06:00 Europe/London instead of the expected 07:00 after the daylight-saving change, even though our finance team has not changed the schedule. The report is linked to our workspace for PO-70312, and we would like to understand whether this is a calendar calculation issue or a profile time-zone setting. Could you confirm the source of the shift so we can correct our close checklist?

Since yesterday at approximately 15:40 UTC, the BigQuery connector for workspace Lumen-Finance-EU has not refreshed the revenue tables used in our monthly variance dashboard. The last successful sync was 14 May, and the delay is affecting our forecast review for contract MSA-2024-119. Please investigate the connector logs and confirm when historical rows from 15 May onward will be backfilled.

Our REST API calls are receiving 429 responses after we moved to the new reporting endpoint described in change note API-2025-04, although our usage appears below the documented 1,000 requests per minute limit. The integration uses key lk_live_9f2 under PO-66410 and mainly pulls invoice status for reconciliation. Could you clarify whether the rate limit is counted per key, per workspace, or per IP range?

The main dashboard domain app.lumen.example is returning 502 errors for all users in our workspace, and scheduled exports to our finance shared drive have failed since 08:10 UTC. This is blocking month-end reporting under contract MSA-2025-003 and affects roughly 85 users across our procurement and FP&A teams. Please escalate immediately and provide an incident reference we can attach to our internal service request.

After we rotated the Okta signing certificate for Lumen SSO, members of workspace Northwind-Group are stuck in a redirect loop when signing in through SAML. The issue appears to involve the identity-provider metadata stored for our enterprise workspace, and it is preventing users from reaching dashboards needed for the quarterly vendor review. Please correct the integration configuration and confirm which team will validate the login path.

I cannot complete two-factor authentication because my registered device was wiped during a corporate phone migration, and I am now unable to access the subscription workspace for PO-80234. Our next vendor payment deadline is tomorrow, and I need either a temporary access code or an identity-verified reset. Please use the recovery contact listed as Marcus Bell in our workspace admin profile, and reference contract MSA-2024-121.

Before our new finance analysts start on 20 May, we need to add 12 users to workspace Acme-Procurement and assign them the Analyst role rather than Viewer. The seat increase is pre-approved under PO-73456 and does not require a plan change. Please confirm when the users can accept invitations without triggering an additional charge.

The only workspace owner for Lumen-Corp has left the company, and we cannot transfer ownership because the departing owner's mailbox is now disabled. Our procurement system requires a named owner before the renewal sign-off for contract MSA-2025-010, and the workspace contains the audit folder for PO-88120. Please initiate an ownership transfer to Dana Whitfield, our current finance controller, using our standard offboarding verification.

We need to grant our finance systems lead, Helen Park, the Invoice Approver role so she can sign off PO-88234 under contract MSA-2025-012 in Lumen, but the admin console says this role requires an upgraded seat type under our current Team plan. Change order CO-441 is already approved, and the role must be active before Friday's procurement committee meeting. Please confirm whether this can be processed as a role correction or whether it requires a new plan order.

Please change the primary notification email for workspace Lumen-APAC from the former employee address ap@oldvendor.example to our shared treasury mailbox treasury@acmecorp.example. The current address belongs to a mailbox that will be deactivated on 30 May and is listed on the admin profile under PO-90441. No invoicing changes are required; we only need the profile update reflected in user invitations and password-reset messages.

Our procurement team must issue a purchase order by Friday for the Enterprise renewal, but we still need a formal quote for 320 seats, 10 read-only API users, and the premium support add-on referenced in draft contract MSA-2025-021. The current Team subscription expires on 31 May, and any lapse would affect our monthly close. Please send the quote with net payment terms and a copy of the order form for signature.

Could you provide indicative pricing for a monthly Starter plan with 25 seats for a 90-day pilot under budget reference PO-90002? We are comparing Lumen against two other analytics vendors for our procurement office, and our finance team would like to see the per-seat cost if we later move to annual invoicing under a small-business contract. No immediate purchase is required.

We are reviewing an upgrade from Team to Enterprise because our BigQuery usage has grown, but finance has asked whether the upgrade quote can be net of the unused portion of invoice INV-20511. The current renewal amount is USD 54,000 under PO-77123, and we have 38 seats that will not be needed until next quarter. Please prepare a net upgrade quote showing the credit applied before the contract amendment is signed.

Please arrange a 30-minute demonstration for our procurement committee focused on audit logs, role-based access, and annual invoicing. The attendees will include Elena Ruiz from vendor management and myself, and we would like to see examples of workspace ownership transfers. The request is linked to our evaluation file PR-2025-441, although no purchase order has been issued yet.

Our legal team is reviewing the master services agreement and needs the completed security addendum, including subprocessors and data-retention terms, for contract MSA-2025-033. Could you also confirm whether the standard order form can reference our preferred payment schedule of net 45 days? We are still in procurement and have not committed to an annual renewal.

Please send the completed W-9 and certificate of insurance for Lumen Analytics Ltd to our supplier onboarding team, quoting vendor ID ACM-2025-0417 and purchase order PO-97011. Our procurement policy requires these documents before we can release the purchase order for the upcoming renewal, and the certificate must show coverage of at least USD 5 million. A PDF by secure email is acceptable.

We are considering a formal reseller partnership for Lumen in the Nordics and would like the partner program overview, referral terms, and API documentation for co-branded dashboards. Our commercial team sees this as separate from our own subscription, which is currently under PO-61555, but we need the materials before the partner summit on 12 June. Please direct the request to the appropriate partnerships contact.

One of our analysts, Priya Raman, noticed a careers posting for a data platform engineer and asked whether Lumen accepts applications through the main careers page or through a referral. This is unrelated to our active subscription under contract MSA-2025-034 or purchase order PO-88124. A brief note is sufficient.

Please remove treasury@acmecorp.example from the marketing list that sent the quarterly analytics newsletter to our shared mailbox. The subscription arrived under our old vendor code LUM-77 but is not related to any active contract or open purchase order. We would prefer not to receive future promotional material while our renewal review under PO-95001 is underway.

Our facilities team would like to know whether Lumen sponsors external finance conferences, as we are compiling a vendor engagement log for audit file PO-96010. There is no request for funding or a contract amendment; we only need to record whether a sponsorship exists for the 2025 procurement calendar. If this information is not tracked, please confirm that as well.
